meta.description: Tell us the job that slows your team down. An engineer, not a salesperson, replies within one working day to book a call.

title: Book a call
lede: Tell us the job that slows your team down. An engineer, not a salesperson, reads every message and replies within one working day to book a 30-minute call.
messageLabel: What job slows your team down?
messageHint: In your own words. For example: "we spend two days a month typing invoices into Xero".
steps: An engineer reads your message. Not a salesperson.
We reply within one working day with a time for a 30-minute call.
You get a written scope: what we would build, what it must not do, how we would measure it and a fixed price for the pilot.
modelsTitle: Not sure how you want to work?
modelsBody: Fixed-scope project, dedicated agent team, embedded engineers or build-operate-transfer. We'll suggest one once we understand the job.
